description: This file contains PHP classes that define the compilation process for {nocache} and {/nocache} tags within the Smarty templating engine. It includes classes that manage entering and leaving nocache mode during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Nocache
classes.description: Handles the compilation of the {nocache} tag, setting the template engine into nocache mode without producing direct output.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Nocacheclose
classes.description: Handles the compilation of the {/nocache} closing tag, exiting nocache mode without producing direct output.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Sets the template compiler into nocache mode when {nocache} is encountered, and exits nocache mode at {/nocache}.
